strings.settings.language.title: Language
strings.settings.language.add_hint: Pick a community .json locale file — copy resources/locales/en.json and translate it (see README → Translations).

strings.hangar.delete_warning: The entry will be DELETED from the hangar.
strings.hangar.inputs_locked_note: Inputs are locked until the decision.
strings.hangar.module_unassigned_note: This module isn't assigned to any ship.
strings.info.cig_asset_note: Official CIG fan asset ("Made by the Community"), unmodified.

strings.inventory.freetext_note: Free text = own depot · picking a match = location entity
strings.inventory.ph_search_item: Search item / commodity … or free text
strings.market.no_key_anon: no UEX API key — UEX loaded anonymously
strings.market.no_terminal_match: No terminal/no commodity matches the filter
strings.market.uex_enrichment_title: UEX enrichment (option b): volume/demand/scarcity — extra info only, not sort-relevant
strings.routes.first_run_note: First run ~1 min, then from cache.
strings.routes.gain_scu_formula_title: Gain/SCU = Sell − Buy · absolute aUEC per SCU
strings.routes.margin_formula_title: Margin = (Sell−Buy) ÷ Buy · relative gain in % (independent of SCU)
strings.routes.margin_relative_title: Margin = relative: Gain/SCU ÷ buy-price difference in % (independent of SCU; not just Gain/SCU rescaled)
strings.routes.profit_sort_toggle_title: Toggle profit/SCU: neutral → descending → ascending → neutral
strings.routes.rb2_budget_title: RB2: quantity buyable with this budget (min SHIP-SCU, floor Budget ÷ buy price)
strings.settings.confirm_note: Confirmation required when creating listings vs. only when removing.
strings.settings.global_registered_note: Global shortcuts registered OS-side — changes take effect immediately without restart.
strings.settings.initial_sync_note: Commodities · terminals · prices — after that, local search starts immediately.
strings.settings.manage_api_keys_uex: Manage API keys on uexcorp.space (login in browser)
strings.settings.manage_secret_uex: Regenerate/copy secret key on uexcorp.space/account (login in browser)
strings.settings.no_price_data_note: Data sources: no price data in cache yet.
strings.shop.click_readonly_note: Click opens the listing on uexcorp.space — read-only, no changes.
strings.shop.create_new_note_title: Create = post NEW listing (UEX marketplace_advertise). There's no editing — unlist + create anew.
strings.shop.create_note: The offer will be CREATED on uexcorp.space. Inputs are locked until the decision.
strings.shop.deal_start_note: — start the deal on the offer page ("Deal"/"Negotiate" on the listing), then negotiate, chat and close here.
strings.shop.description_hint_title: Free text, multi-line (Markdown ok, max. 65,535 characters) — Enter = new line
strings.shop.from_uex_client: Own offers + marketplace trades from the UEX client.
strings.shop.hidden_listing_title: Hidden listing only appears after manual UEX approval
strings.shop.image_note: UEX transfers 1 image per listing (image_data) — a newly chosen image replaces the old one.
strings.shop.need_api_key_note: Own offers + marketplace trades need your UEX API key — without a key the section stays empty.
strings.shop.negotiate_browser_title: Negotiation starts on uexcorp.space (no POST /marketplace_negotiations on the API side) — open the offer page in the browser
strings.shop.no_edit_note_title: There's no editing: unlist and create anew (2-step confirms both)
strings.shop.nothing_sent: No data has been sent to UEX yet.
strings.shop.open_listings_manager_title: Open own listings in UEX manager (login in browser)
strings.shop.pending_moderation_title: UEX hasn't approved this listing yet — it only appears publicly after moderation.
strings.shop.price_hint_title: Price (integer, thousand separators shown as you type)
strings.shop.remove_local_title: Remove local entry (needed if UEX rejected the listing)
strings.shop.saved_locally_title: Saved locally — UEX doesn't list pending ads via API; after approval the listing appears as an active listing on the next pull.
strings.shop.secret_missing: Secret key missing or wrong — see settings
strings.shop.unlist_note: The listing will be UNLISTED on uexcorp.space.
strings.shop.user_scoped_note: User-scoped reads (own offers, marketplace trades) need the "UEX personal secret key" (40 characters) in addition to the app key — exactly as registered on uexcorp.space.
strings.trades.date_uex_note_title: Date is set by UEX when recording (today) — the API has no date field.
strings.trades.deal_start_title: Start deal: begin negotiation on uexcorp.space (not possible via API, therefore browser)
strings.trades.delete_warning: The trade will be DELETED on uexcorp.space — this cannot be undone.
strings.trades.form.title: Record trade
strings.trades.negotiate_browser_note: in the browser — create, chat and close the deal there. You'll then see both sides in the Trades tab.
strings.trades.no_messages: No messages in this negotiation yet.
strings.trades.open_trade_log_uex_title: Open trade log on uexcorp.space (login in browser)
strings.trades.open_trades_manager_title: Open own trades in UEX manager (login in browser)
strings.shop.appears_after_approval: It appears in your offers list after UEX approval.
strings.trades.no_commodity_trades: No commodity trades recorded yet — record your first trade (“+ Record trade”) or run it directly on UEX.
strings.shop.approval_stale_note: The listing has not appeared in the UEX API for over 24 h — approval unconfirmed (possibly rejected). Check it in the listings manager.
strings.inventory.empty_note: Inventory empty — record the first position with N.
strings.settings.key_unsupported: Key {key} is not supported — use a letter, digit, F1–F24, or a main-keyboard special key.
strings.shop.no_offers_for_user: No offers of your own for “{user}” on UEX.
strings.shop.img_too_big: Image “{name}” is larger than 10 MB (UEX limit).
strings.settings.sc_locked_note: Locked for global hotkeys: F-keys are the mode hotkeys (configurable, section “Mode-Hotkeys”), F5 runs the resync. Other internal bindings: Esc, Enter, Tab, arrow keys, m, Alt+digits.
strings.settings.omarchy_sync_ok: Hyprland binds are driven from the saved shortcuts
strings.settings.omarchy_sync_pending: Saved shortcuts are the canonical source, but the Hyprland binds are not driven from them yet.
strings.settings.omasettings_missing: OmaSettings plugin not found — create binds manually
strings.settings.no_foreign_hyprland: The app does not modify foreign Hyprland configuration.
strings.settings.wayland_no_hyprland: the saved combinations remain the canonical source; create compositor binds manually per docs/WAYLAND.md.
strings.settings.f5_reserved: F5 is firmly reserved for the resync (marketplace, my shop, route sweep) and cannot be assigned to any mode. Changes apply immediately.
strings.settings.secret_key_note: For your own shop (“My Shop”, user-scoped reads) UEX additionally needs your personal secret key (40 characters, even more masked than the app key). Generate/copy the key on uexcorp.space — the overlay derives the username from it automatically.
strings.settings.prices_commodity_note: Commodity prices: {age} since sync · {n} commodities · hourly automatic
strings.settings.prices_item_note: Item prices: {age} since sync · {n} items · constant per patch (no auto-sync)
strings.settings.updater_note: Overlay {version} · checked against the Gitea release (every {hours} h, a single GET — no telemetry).
strings.market.offline_stale: Offline · cache from {age} · prices may be stale
strings.shop.recreate_note: This form is PRE-FILLED from “{title}”. To change it you must first UNLIST the old listing (below) and then create a new one with the new values — UEX does not support editing.
strings.info.about_body: Architects Overlay is an unofficial community project for Star Citizen: trading routes, marketplace prices and hangar management directly in-game — an overlay from the community, for the community. Non-commercial, without RSI/CIG assets as own branding.
strings.info.disclaimer_body: Architects Overlay is not affiliated with Cloud Imperium Games (CIG), Roberts Space Industries or any of their partners and is not officially supported or sponsored. Star Citizen, Roberts Space Industries and the RSI logo are trademarks of Cloud Imperium Games Corp.
strings.error.uex.username_no_secret: No personal secret key set — username cannot be determined.
strings.error.update.none: No update available — nothing to install.
strings.hangar.err_modules_note: Modules are no longer created separately — add them in the ship detail under “Modules”
strings.hotkeys.err_f5: {slot}: F5 is reserved for the resync
strings.hotkeys.err_f5_noslot: F5 is reserved for the resync
strings.overlay.err_register_occupied: Shortcut {combo} could not be registered (already in use elsewhere?): {err} — the previous shortcut stays active.
strings.overlay.err_state_unavailable: Overlay state unavailable — shortcut not changed.
strings.shortcuts.err_duplicate: This combination is already the {peer} shortcut — the same key cannot be assigned twice.
strings.shortcuts.err_escape: Escape is not allowed as a shortcut (cancel/back in every view).
strings.shortcuts.err_multi_main: Multiple main keys — exactly one normal key per shortcut.
strings.shortcuts.err_need_main: A normal main key is missing (modifier keys alone are not enough).
strings.shortcuts.err_need_mod: At least one modifier key (Ctrl/Alt/Shift/Win) plus a normal key.
strings.shortcuts.err_numpad: Numpad keys are not supported — use the main keyboard.
strings.shortcuts.err_reserved: Internally reserved: {key} ({what}) — both would fire in the focused overlay. Choose another key.
strings.shortcuts.err_reserved_alt_digit: Internally reserved: Alt+{key} (focus offer hit {key}) — choose another combination.
strings.shortcuts.err_unknown_key: Unknown key {tok} — cannot be registered as a global shortcut.
strings.sync.compositor_disabled: Compositor sync disabled — saved shortcuts stay active, system binds are no longer changed.
strings.sync.compositor_noop: Compositor sync active — system binds already match the saved shortcuts.
strings.sync.compositor_plugin_missing: Compositor sync: Hyprland is running, but the OmaSettings plugin was not found. Create the binds manually: docs/WAYLAND.md.
strings.sync.err_lua_syntax: Sync {command}: binds written, but {err} — undo the changes via {backup}
strings.sync.err_mismatch: Sync written, but Hyprland shows {command} as key {key} modmask {mask} instead of {want_key} modmask {want_mask} (5 check rounds) — check the store.
strings.sync.err_nobind: Sync written, but no bind {description} found in hyprctl binds (5 check rounds) — check reload/lua.
strings.sync.err_unbindable_key: Key {key} cannot be bound under Hyprland — choose another key.
strings.update.deb_hint:
Self-update is not possible for .deb installations (no root actions from the app).
Update via download + apt:
  curl -Lo {path} "{url}"
  sudo apt install {path}
strings.update.err_appimage_only: AppImage update only possible on Linux.
strings.update.err_binary_only: Binary update only possible on Linux.
strings.update.err_checksum_mismatch: SHA256 check failed (expected {expected}, got {actual}) — update rejected.
strings.update.err_insecure_url: Update URL is not HTTPS — rejected: {url}
strings.update.err_no_asset: No matching asset in release {tag} for this platform
strings.update.err_no_checksum: No SHA256 checksum for {asset} in the release — update rejected for security reasons.
strings.update.err_none_available: No update available — nothing to install.
strings.update.err_too_large: Download larger than the limit ({limit} bytes) — rejected.
strings.update.err_windows_only: Windows installer only possible on Windows.
strings.update.note_barebin_done: Update v{version} installed — restart the overlay to apply (systemd restart or close/open the overlay).
strings.update.note_nsis_done: Update v{version} loaded — setup runs in the background, the overlay will be closed.
strings.update.note_uptodate: No update found — v{version} is up to date.
strings.update.reason_deb_apt: .deb installations update via apt — the app performs no root actions.
strings.calc.err_incomplete: Expression incomplete (e.g. operator at the end)
